name: Multiple Event Reminders for Event Espresso
author: Emilio Valdés Reyes

sections.description:
Multiple Event Reminders for Event Espresso is a powerful add-on designed to extend the communication capabilities of Event Espresso.

While the standard notification system is great, complex events often require a more robust reminder strategy to ensure attendance. This plugin solves that problem by allowing you to schedule multiple email reminders with precise timing.

Stop worrying about “no-shows” and start engaging your attendees at the right moment.

Key Features

  • Unlimited Reminders: Create as many notification instances as you need for a single event.
  • Granular Precision (Days & Hours): Unlike standard tools that might limit you to days, this plugin allows you to mix and match.
    • Example: Send a “Preparation Guide” 2 Days before the event.
    • Example: Send a “Link to Join” 1 Hour before the event.
  • Automated Workflow: Built on top of the native WordPress cron system for reliability. Set it up once, and it runs automatically.
  • Native Integration: Works directly within the Event Espresso event editor interface.

How it works

  1. Go to your Event Espresso event editor.
  2. Locate the new “Multiple Reminders” meta box.
  3. Add your reminders, define the timing (e.g., 24 hours before), and customize the message.
  4. Save the event. The plugin handles the rest.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher.
  • Event Espresso Core plugin installed and active.
  • EE Automated Upcoming Event Notifications Add-on plugin installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/multiple-event-reminders-for-event-espresso directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure you have Event Espresso installed and active.
  4. Go to any Event Espresso event to start configuring your reminders.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Event Espresso and EE Automated Upcoming Event Notifications Add-on?

Yes, this is an add-on for Event Espresso and EE Automated Upcoming Event Notifications Add-on and relies on its core functionality to identify events and attendees.

Can I send different emails at different times?

Yes! You can configure a specific email template for “1 Week Before” and a completely different message for “1 Hour Before”.

Is this an official Event Espresso plugin?

No, this is a third-party extension developed to add specific functionality (multiple granular reminders) not present in the core add-ons.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fix: Added dependency checks for Event Espresso core and the AUEN add-on. If either is missing, this plugin now auto-deactivates and displays an admin notice (instead of causing a fatal error).

1.0.1

  • Fix: Resolved fatal error when ‘EE Automated Upcoming Event Notifications’ is deactivated.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for multiple reminders based on days and hours.
  • Integrated batch processing for high-volume sending.
